veranderings.voor: klop vinniger en
veranderings.na: klop vinniger, en
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: jou spiere trek styf oor jou skouers
veranderings.na: jou skouerspiere trek styf
veranderings.rede: 'spiere trek styf oor jou skouers' is a literal construction; 'skouerspiere trek styf' is the natural Afrikaans and saves words.

veranderings.voor: die netbalspan en jou naam
veranderings.na: die netbalspan, en jou naam
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: two clauses with their own subject and verb joined by 'en'.

veranderings.voor: Jou keel voel toe en jy
veranderings.na: Jou keel voel toe, en jy
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: two clauses with their own subject and verb joined by 'en'.

veranderings.voor: stiller as woede en ander mense
veranderings.na: stiller as woede, en ander mense
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: two clauses with their own subject and verb joined by 'en'.

veranderings.voor: 'n Ouma sterf of 'n vriend
veranderings.na: 'n Ouma sterf, of 'n vriend
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'of' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Hartseer wys nie by almal op dieselfde manier nie.
veranderings.na: Hartseer lyk nie by almal dieselfde nie.
veranderings.rede: Intransitive 'wys' here follows English 'shows'; 'lyk nie by almal dieselfde nie' is more natural and shorter.

veranderings.voor: huil sommer dadelik en 'n ander kind
veranderings.na: huil sommer dadelik, en 'n ander kind
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: two clauses with their own subject and verb joined by 'en'.

veranderings.voor: Al drie is hartseer en niemand
veranderings.na: Al drie is hartseer, en niemand
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: two clauses with their own subject and verb joined by 'en'.

veranderings.blok: Wat jy met 'n groot gevoel kan doen
veranderings.voor: Wag voor jy praat as die woede opkom en stap weg
veranderings.na: As die woede opkom, wag voor jy praat en stap weg
veranderings.rede: 'voor jy praat as die woede opkom' can be read as 'before you speak when the anger rises'; fronting the condition makes clear it governs both commands.

veranderings.blok: Wat jy met 'n groot gevoel kan doen
veranderings.voor: die teleurstelling hardop
veranderings.na: hul teleurstelling hardop
veranderings.rede: The disappointment is their own; the possessive reads more naturally than the definite article.

veranderings.blok: Om in iemand anders se plek te dink
veranderings.voor: Om in iemand anders se plek te dink
veranderings.na: Om jou in iemand anders se plek in te dink
veranderings.rede: The Afrikaans idiom is reflexive 'jou in iemand se plek indink'; 'in iemand se plek dink' is not idiomatic.

veranderings.blok: Om in iemand anders se plek te dink
veranderings.voor: jou in sy plek dink
veranderings.na: jou in sy plek indink
veranderings.rede: The idiom takes the separable verb 'indink' ('jou in iemand se plek indink').

veranderings.blok: Voel vir hom en wil help
veranderings.voor: voel jy vir hom en jy wil
veranderings.na: voel jy vir hom, en jy wil
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: two clauses with their own subject and verb joined by 'en'.

veranderings.voor: Hy kan wel bly waar sy maat is.
veranderings.na: Hy kan wel by sy maat bly.
veranderings.rede: 'bly waar sy maat is' is wooden; 'by sy maat bly' is the natural phrase, keeps the meaning and matches 'Bly by jou maat' later in the lesson.

veranderings.voor: Dit kan die grootmens by die huis wees
veranderings.na: Dit kan 'n grootmens by die huis wees
veranderings.rede: The three options are parallel ('n onderwyser, 'n verpleegster), so the indefinite article fits; 'die grootmens' suggests one specific person.

veranderings.voor: jou wil laat terugstoot
veranderings.na: jou laat wil terugstoot
veranderings.rede: The intended meaning is that the feeling makes you want to push back ('laat wil'); 'wil laat' says the feeling wants to make you.

veranderings.voor: as iets seermaak
veranderings.na: as iets jou seermaak
veranderings.rede: 'seermaak' needs an object here, as in the study text ('wanneer iets jou seermaak').

veranderings.voor: jou in iemand anders se plek te dink
veranderings.na: jou in iemand anders se plek in te dink
veranderings.rede: The idiom takes the separable verb 'indink'.

veranderings.voor: met 'n dood daarby
veranderings.na: met 'n sterfgeval daarby
veranderings.rede: 'met 'n dood daarby' is clumsy; 'sterfgeval' is the standard noun for a death in this sense.
